verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂਆ ਮਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਅਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pasooaa manukh dheh a(n)tar a(n)tar ihai sabadh surat ko bibek abibek hai ||

en.bdb: The only difference in human and animal body is that a human is aware of the union of consciousness and the holy word of the Guru but animal has no such knowledge nor any ability.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਹਰਿਆਉ ਕਹਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਅਨਸੁਨਿਓ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pasoo hariaau kahio sunio anasunio karai maanas janam upadhes ridhai Tek hai ||

en.bdb: If an animal is asked to stay away from green fields, or pasture land, it ignores it but a human being lodges the teachings of the True Guru in his heart and adheres to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂਆ ਸਬਦ ਹੀਨ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pasooaa sabadh heen jihabaa na bol sakai maanas janam bolai bachan anek hai ||

en.bdb: Devoid of words, an animal cannot speak with its tongue but a human can speak several words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਨਾਤੁਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਹੰੂ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੦॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat sun samajh bolai bibekee naatur achet pas pret ha(n)oo mai ek hai ||200||

en.bdb: If a man listens, understands and speaks the words of Guru, he is a wise and intelligent person. Otherwise he too is one among the ignorant animal and a fool. (200)
